# MonsterBrainSoup

> > Art portfolio and creative projects of Lukas Stormskull, featuring dragon character creators, otherkin identity exploration, and monster-themed digital art.

MonsterBrainSoup showcases interactive tools like Dragon Builder (a JavaScript dollmaker), collaborative projects like Umbral Wings Dragon Tarot, and essays on monster taxonomy, identity, and worldbuilding. The site blends technical creativity with personal exploration of nonhuman identity and alternative self-expression.

## Key Topics

- Dragon Builder (character creator)
- Lukas Stormskull (artist)
- Umbral Wings Dragon Tarot
- Otherkin and nonhuman identity
- Furcadia (virtual world)
- Monster taxonomy and categorization
- Dollmaker and avatar creators
- Flight Rising
- Worldbuilding tools (Aerill project)
- Creative self-expression
- Digital art and design
- Kickstarter projects
- Seamless pattern design
- Color palette tools

- [Dragon Builder Limbs Update - MonsterBrainSoup](https://monsterbrainsoup.com/dragon-builder-limbs-update): Dragon Builder update: new limb options for wyverns, lindwyrms & more

## Monster Theory & Identity

- [What defines a monster? - MonsterBrainSoup](https://monsterbrainsoup.com/what-defines-a-monster): Essay exploring monster definition, etymology & cultural symbolism
- [Monster Categorization - MonsterBrainSoup](https://monsterbrainsoup.com/monster-categorization): Monster taxonomy analysis: categorizing creatures by origin & type
- [Adopt a Dragon - A Nostalgic Retrospective - MonsterBrainSoup](https://monsterbrainsoup.com/adopt-a-dragon): Nostalgic look at 90s/2000s virtual pet & dragon adoption websites
